name: week
title: Expenses this week
subtitle: Claims waiting, card charges with no claim, and what the checks found

sections.title: Waiting for approval
sections.note: Days waiting since the claim was submitted. The approver is the claimant's manager.
sections.sql: select ref,person,approver,submitted_on,days_waiting,currency,total_cents,missing_receipts from claim_totals where status='submitted' order by days_waiting desc

sections.title: Approved, not yet batched
sections.sql: select ref,person,entity,currency,total_cents,reimburse_cents,decided_by,decided_on from claim_totals where status='approved' and batch_id is null order by entity,ref

sections.title: Card charges with no claim
sections.sql: select external_ref,txn_date,person,merchant,currency,amount_cents,age_days from card_work where line_id is null order by txn_date

sections.title: What the checks found
sections.note: Rules and sources are in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule,ref,subject,finding from compliance_findings order by rule,ref

name: tax
title: GST and entertainment
subtitle: GST supported by the right document, GST at risk, and the entertainment record

sections.title: GST by month
sections.note: At risk: the document held does not support the credit, or there is no receipt at all.
sections.sql: select entity,home_currency as currency,to_char(spent_on,'YYYY-MM') as month,sum(gst_cents)::bigint as gst_cents,count(*)::int as lines from line_work where claim_status not in ('draft','rejected') and gst_cents>0 group by 1,2,3 order by 1,3 desc

sections.title: GST credits without the right document
sections.sql: select rule,ref,subject,finding from compliance_findings where rule in ('EX02','EX03') order by ref

sections.title: Entertainment
sections.sql: select entity,ref,person,spent_on,merchant,category_name as category,attendee_count,attendees,business_purpose,home_currency as currency,home_cents as total_cents from line_work where entertainment and claim_status not in ('draft','rejected') order by entity,spent_on

sections.title: Last three months
sections.note: Net is the amount less GST, in each entity's own currency.
sections.sql: select to_char(spent_on,'YYYY-MM') as month,entity,home_currency as currency,cost_centre,category_name as category,count(*)::int as lines,sum(home_cents-gst_cents)::bigint as net_cents,sum(home_cents)::bigint as total_cents from line_work where claim_status not in ('draft','rejected') and spent_on>=(date_trunc('month',current_date)-interval '2 months')::date group by 1,2,3,4,5 order by 1 desc,2,4

sections.title: By person
sections.sql: select person,entity,currency,count(*)::int as claims,sum(total_cents)::bigint as total_cents from claim_totals where status not in ('draft','rejected') group by 1,2,3 order by 5 desc
